aesthetic: The Spread — a private-equity-owned trading desk's deal blotter
anchor: The financial-print deal book (FT salmon-stock tombstone tables, LBO sources-and-uses ledgers) crossed with the programmatic bid-waterfall MiQ trades on — read as a thin bright margin captured atop rented infrastructure.
rationale: MiQ's defining fact is not a technology but a financial structure: a managed-service trading desk, PE-owned and assembled to sell, that captures a spread between advertiser money and inventory it routes through DSPs it does not own, on data it rents. So the corpus's native world is financial print, not a terminal — a serif deal-book voice (no ad-tech sibling uses serif), tombstone cream and ledger rules, with a single warm vermilion marking the margin layer MiQ keeps.

fonts.display: 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Palatino, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
fonts.body: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
fonts.mono: 'Courier New', Courier, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace
